title: Swift
description: The first time you play this card, draw [blue]1-3[/blue] cards.
extra_card_text: Draw 1-3 cards the first time this is played.
notes: The enchantment triggers only once when the card is first played, then becomes disabled. The amount of cards drawn varies by source: Wing Charm grants 1, Self-Help Book grants 2, and Beautiful Bracelet grants 3.
